about: The move library of the voxel-diorama kit: named tricks a shot can call. 'use_when' is the job the move does for the viewer; 'how' is the shot-list field. The Pocket indexes these as kind 'move'. Rule: pick a move for its job, never for decoration; at most two different moves per shot; no move more than three times in a film.

moves.name: Punch word
moves.use_when: one word carries the beat and must land on its spoken time

moves.name: Marker box
moves.use_when: a word inside a sentence is the answer or the name to remember

moves.name: Coloured letters drop in
moves.use_when: a question, a playful or uncertain word, the start of a hook

moves.name: Typed text
moves.use_when: the line is something a person types or a machine prints: a prompt, a command, a search

moves.name: Corner brackets
moves.use_when: isolating one term as a thing being examined or targeted

moves.name: Number counts up
moves.use_when: a figure is the point of the beat

moves.name: Word standing in the world
moves.use_when: the punch word should feel like an object the camera passes
moves.how: type3d: [{ text, t, at, size, anim: "slam" | "swing" | "rise" | "drop" }]

moves.name: Word flies through the lens
moves.use_when: a hard correction or reversal: the word hits the viewer and wipes the frame
moves.how: type3d: [{ text, t, at: [0, 10, -30], size: 8, anim: "through", dur: 1 }]

moves.name: Sticker burst
moves.use_when: a moment of delight, a win, or sarcasm about hype; shapes pop around a line
moves.how: burst: [{ t, x, y, n: 7, kinds: ["star", "spark", "heart", "bolt"] }]

moves.name: Typed search bar
moves.use_when: the viewer's own question or prompt is being asked
moves.how: search: { text, t: [a, b], x, y, w }

moves.name: Level bar
moves.use_when: a degree: skill, progress, quality, how far along
moves.how: meter: { label, value: 0.75, t, x, y }

moves.name: Cursor travels and clicks
moves.use_when: an action the viewer can take: press, choose, send
moves.how: cursor: { from: [x, y], to: [x, y], t: [a, b] }

moves.name: Card fan
moves.use_when: several versions, options or steps shown at once
moves.how: fan: { t, at: [x, y, z], labels: ["v1", …] }

moves.name: Film strip through the frame
moves.use_when: a flood of similar things: generic content, a feed, many videos
moves.how: strip: { t: [a, b], at: [x, y, z], count: 9 }

moves.name: Floating icon cards
moves.use_when: the parts of a system named one by one
moves.how: cards: [{ id, label, icon, at, t }]

moves.name: The document prop
moves.use_when: a file, a skill, a script is the hero object

moves.name: Into the monitor
moves.use_when: showing a chat, code or a timeline as proof

moves.name: Change of world
moves.use_when: a new idea, a time jump, or the film has stayed in one place for 8 s
moves.how: the next shot names another `set`; join with `flash`, `iris`, `mosaic` or `pixelate`

moves.name: Flash cut
moves.use_when: a revelation or a hard turn

moves.name: Iris
moves.use_when: closing one chapter on a single subject and opening the next

moves.name: Pixel flood
moves.use_when: a change of subject inside the pixel world

moves.name: Step into a picture
moves.use_when: the story goes somewhere vast or impossible

moves.name: Take off and fly
moves.use_when: freedom, speed, escaping a limit; one impossible moment

moves.name: Jump with squash and stretch
moves.use_when: joy, a win, a beat on the music

moves.name: Run in
moves.use_when: an entrance with urgency

moves.name: A new character from one picture
moves.use_when: the story needs a third voice, a customer, a rival
moves.how: scripts/sprite_import.py, then cast: { name: { src, tall } }

moves.name: Push in
moves.use_when: the claim gets personal or important

moves.name: Dolly past
moves.use_when: showing depth and place; a calm line

moves.name: Crane up
moves.use_when: revealing scale or ending a chapter

moves.name: Pull back
moves.use_when: the subject turns out to be part of something bigger

moves.name: Push through
moves.use_when: diving from the whole into one detail

moves.name: Snap zoom
moves.use_when: a punch word or a comic beat needs a jolt
moves.how: cam: { preset: "snap-zoom", on, snap: { t, fov: 17 } }

moves.name: Dutch tilt
moves.use_when: something is wrong, tense or chaotic

moves.name: Vertigo
moves.use_when: a realisation: the world shifts around a still subject

moves.name: Over the shoulder
moves.use_when: one character shows or tells another

moves.name: Top down
moves.use_when: a layout, a process, a plan

moves.name: Orbit
moves.use_when: presenting the subject as a hero

moves.name: Shake
moves.use_when: an impact or a chaotic second, never a whole shot of calm speech

moves.name: Rack focus
moves.use_when: attention moves from the speaker to the thing
